content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NBRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NBRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the CSIR NBRI recruitment is scheduled for 18 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the CSIR NBRI recruitment?
faq.answer: CSIR NBRI is recruiting for Project Associate-I, Project Associate-II, and Project Assistant-II positions. A total of 7 vacancies are available across these roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Assistant-II?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant-II position, candidates need to have a B.Sc. degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, or a B.Sc. in Biological sciences (ZBC or others).

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: No specific prior experience is mentioned as mandatory for the Project Associate-I position. However, candidates with certain qualifications like CSIR-UGC NET may receive higher pay.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these CSIR NBRI posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts (Project Associate-I, Project Associate-II, and Project Assistant-II) is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations available for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates (05 years) and OBC candidates (03 years) as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate-II ranges from Rs. 28,000/- + HRA (for others) to Rs. 35,000/- + HRA (for NET/GATE qualified candidates).

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the CSIR National Botanical Research Institute (CSIR NBRI) office in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original documents, including certificates of examinations passed (from matriculation onwards), date of birth certificate, experience certificates, and one latest photograph.

faq.question: Q10. How can I get the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form in advance from the website www.nbri.res.in, or it will be provided at the venue on the date of the walk-in interview.
